title: Correct change magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (1) must be 4.0 kg·m/s.

title: Correct average force
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (2) must be 20 N.

title: Vector momentum calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate initial and final momentum as vectors, accounting for the sign/direction change.

title: Applies impulse-momentum theorem
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the formula F_avg = Δp / Δt to find the average force.

title: Defines change in momentum
description: Important Criteria: The student must define Δp as p_final - p_initial, not just a difference in magnitudes.

title: Includes units
description: Optional Criteria: The student includes correct units (kg·m/s and N) with their numerical answers.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student treats the momenta as scalars and simply adds 1.6 and 2.4, or ignores the negative sign in the force.

title: Incorrect formula application
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses F = mΔv/Δt without considering the vector nature of Δv, or confuses force with momentum.
